description_en: Queries the plan information about an SQL statement such as a query statement or an extract-transform-load (ETL) task statement
description_zh: 调用DescribeSQLPlan接口查询目标SQL，例如查询语句或ETL（Extract Transform Load）任务语句的计划信息
name: DescribeSQLPlan

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The query ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612277.html operation to query the IDs of queries that are being executed
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612277.html接口查看目标SQL的任务ID
parameters.name: process_id

Detail.description_en: The execution information about the SQL statement

CPUTime.description_en: The total CPU time consumed by all operators on multithreaded servers when the SQL statement is executed. Unit: milliseconds
CPUTime.description_zh: 执行目标SQL时，算子处理数据单元的总耗时，是多服务器多线程上的累计值。单位为毫秒（ms）

ClientIP.description_en: The IP address of the client that is used to execute the SQL statement
ClientIP.description_zh: 提交目标SQL语句的客户端IP地址

Database.description_en: The name of the database on which the SQL statement was executed
Database.description_zh: 执行目标SQL的数据库名称

OutputRows.description_en: The total number of rows generated by the SQL statement

OutputSize.description_en: The total amount of data generated by the SQL statement. Unit: bytes
OutputSize.description_zh: 目标SQL语句的总输出数据量，单位为Byte

PeakMemory.description_en: The maximum memory usage when the SQL statement is executed. Unit: bytes
PeakMemory.description_zh: 执行目标SQL时的峰值内存，单位为Byte

PlanningTime.description_en: The amount of time consumed to generate the execution plan of the SQL statement. Unit: milliseconds
PlanningTime.description_zh: 执行目标SQL时生成执行计划的时间，单位为毫秒（ms）

QueuedTime.description_en: The amount of time consumed to queue the SQL statement. Unit: milliseconds
QueuedTime.description_zh: 执行目标SQL的排队时间，单位为毫秒（ms）

StartTime.description_en: The execution start time of the SQL statement. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 目标SQL语句的执行开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

State.description_en:
The final execution state of the SQL statement. Valid values:

FINISHED
FAILED
State.description_zh:
目标SQL语句的最终执行状态，取值范围如下：
FINISHED：完成。
FAILED ：失败

TotalStage.description_en: The total number of stages in the SQL statement
TotalStage.description_zh: 目标SQL中包含的总阶段个数

TotalTask.description_en: The total number of tasks in the SQL statement
TotalTask.description_zh: 目标SQL中包含的总任务个数

TotalTime.description_en: The total amount of time consumed to execute the SQL statement. Unit: milliseconds
TotalTime.description_zh: 目标SQL的执行总耗时，单位为毫秒（ms）

User.description_en: The name of the user who submitted the SQL statement
User.description_zh: 提交目标SQL语句的用户名

OriginInfo.description_en: The original information about the SQL statement

StageList.description_en: The queried plan in different stages

CPUTimeAvg.description_en: The average `CPU Time` value on each compute node in the stage. Unit: milliseconds
CPUTimeAvg.description_zh: 该阶段的`CPU Time`在各个计算节点的平均值，单位为毫秒（ms）

CPUTimeMax.description_en: The maximum `CPU Time` value on each compute node in the stage. Unit: milliseconds
CPUTimeMax.description_zh: 该阶段的`CPU Time`在各个计算节点的最大值，单位为毫秒（ms）

CPUTimeMin.description_en: The minimum `CPU Time` value on each compute node in the stage. Unit: milliseconds
CPUTimeMin.description_zh: 该阶段的`CPU Time`在各个计算节点的最小值，单位为毫秒（ms）

InputSizeAvg.description_en: The average amount of input data on each compute node in the stage. Unit: bytes
InputSizeAvg.description_zh: 阶段在各个计算节点的输入数据量的平均值，单位为Byte

InputSizeMax.description_en: The maximum amount of input data on each compute node in the stage. Unit: byte
InputSizeMax.description_zh: 阶段在各个计算节点的输入数据量的最大值，单位为Byte

InputSizeMin.description_en: The minimum amount of input data on each compute node in the stage. Unit: bytes
InputSizeMin.description_zh: 阶段在各个计算节点的输入数据量的最小值，单位为Byte

OperatorCost.description_en: The total CPU time consumed by all operators in the stage, which is equivalent to the total CPU time of the stage. You can use this parameter to determine which parts of the stage consume a large amount of computing resources. Unit: milliseconds
OperatorCost.description_zh: 该阶段内部总的算子耗时，等同于该阶段的CPU Time，可用于判断查询哪些部分消耗了较多的计算资源。单位为毫秒（ms）

PeakMemory.description_en: The maximum memory usage when the SQL statement is executed. Unit: bytes
PeakMemory.description_zh: 执行目标SQL时的峰值内存，单位为Byte

ScanSizeAvg.description_en: The average amount of data scanned by a scan operator on each storage node in the stage. Unit: bytes
ScanSizeAvg.description_zh: 带数据扫描算子的阶段在各个存储节点的扫描数据量的平均值，单位为Byte

ScanSizeMax.description_en: The maximum amount of data scanned by a scan operator on each storage node in the stage. Unit: bytes
ScanSizeMax.description_zh: 带数据扫描算子的阶段在各个存储节点的扫描数据量的最大值，单位为Byte

ScanSizeMin.description_en: The minimum amount of data scanned by a scan operator on each storage node in the stage. Unit: bytes
ScanSizeMin.description_zh: 带数据扫描算子的阶段在各个存储节点的扫描数据量的最小值，单位为Byte

ScanTimeAvg.description_en: The average amount of time consumed by a scan operator to read data on each storage node in the stage. Unit: milliseconds
ScanTimeAvg.description_zh: 带数据扫描算子的阶段在各个存储节点读取数据耗时的平均值，单位为毫秒（ms）

ScanTimeMax.description_en: The maximum amount of time consumed by a scan operator to read data on each storage node in the stage. Unit: milliseconds
ScanTimeMax.description_zh: 带数据扫描算子的阶段在各个存储节点读取数据耗时的最大值，单位为毫秒（ms）

ScanTimeMin.description_en: The minimum amount of time consumed by a scan operator to read data on each storage node in the stage. Unit: milliseconds
ScanTimeMin.description_zh: 带数据扫描算子的阶段在各个存储节点读取数据耗时的最小值，单位为毫秒（ms）

State.description_en:
The final execution state of the stage. Valid values:

FINISHED
CANCELED
ABORTED
FAILED
State.description_zh:
该计划阶段的最终执行状态，取值范围如下：
FINISHED：完成。
CANCELED：取消。
ABORTED：中止。
FAILED：失败
